name: Goku
description: The main protagonist of the Dragon Ball franchise, Goku is a Saiyan warrior who came to Earth as a baby. He is known for his incredible strength, determination, unwavering optimism, and his constant desire to get stronger. Despite his Saiyan heritage, Goku is incredibly kind-hearted and always strives to protect his friends and family. He is a master of martial arts and has trained under many powerful teachers, allowing him to reach incredible heights of power.

name: Vegeta
description: The proud prince of the Saiyan race, Vegeta is Goku's eternal rival. He is known for his arrogance, ambition, and powerful strength. Despite his initially antagonistic nature, Vegeta has developed a sense of loyalty to his adopted home, Earth, and his family. He is driven by a desire to become the strongest warrior in the universe and constantly strives to surpass Goku.

name: Piccolo
description: A powerful Namekian warrior who initially served as an antagonist, Piccolo eventually becomes a valued ally and mentor to Goku and his friends.  Piccolo has a stoic personality and is known for his strength and wisdom.  He is devoted to protecting Earth and has become a father figure to Gohan.

name: Gohan
description: Goku's son, Gohan is a powerful Saiyan with a strong sense of justice and a penchant for studying. Initially reluctant to embrace his Saiyan heritage, Gohan eventually comes to terms with his power and becomes a formidable warrior.  Despite his strength, Gohan prioritizes his studies and family life.

name: Frieza
description: A ruthless and powerful space tyrant, Frieza is one of the most iconic villains in the Dragon Ball franchise. He is known for his cold-hearted nature, extreme power, and his incredible strength. Frieza is driven by an insatiable thirst for power and is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve his goals.
key_events: Defeat at the hands of Goku

name: Cell
description: A bio-engineered android created by Dr. Gero, Cell is a powerful and cunning antagonist who seeks to absorb the energy of other fighters to achieve his perfect form.  Cell is a ruthless and arrogant fighter who enjoys tormenting his opponents and reveling in his power.
key_events: Defeat at the hands of Gohan

name: Majin Buu
description: A powerful and playful creature of pure energy, Majin Buu is an unpredictable and destructive antagonist who can absorb other beings to increase his power.  Buu is known for his childlike nature and his tendency to act on his impulses.  He is often unaware of the consequences of his actions, leading to widespread destruction.
key_events: Splitting into Good and Evil Buu
Defeat at the hands of Goku

name: Broly
description: A legendary Saiyan warrior with immense power, Broly is known for his overwhelming strength and uncontrollable rage.  Broly's power is said to surpass even that of a Super Saiyan God, making him a formidable opponent for even the strongest warriors. His rage is triggered by the presence of Goku, resulting in a deep hatred and an insatiable desire for vengeance.
key_events: Confrontation with Goku on Planet Vegeta
Attacks earth and fights Goku and friends

name: Beerus
description: The God of Destruction of Universe 7, Beerus is a powerful and enigmatic deity who enjoys challenging strong fighters.  Beerus has a playful yet dangerous personality, often using his power for his own amusement.  He is known for his love of food and his desire to find worthy opponents.
key_events: Awakening and search for the Super Saiyan God

name: Whis
description: Beerus's loyal attendant and mentor, Whis is an angel with immense power and wisdom.  Whis is calm and collected, often observing events with a detached amusement.  He is a skilled martial artist and possesses a vast understanding of the universe.
key_events: Helping Goku become a Super Saiyan God
Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Jiren
description: A powerful warrior from Universe 11, Jiren is known for his stoic nature and his incredible strength. Jiren is a master of martial arts and possesses immense power, even surpassing that of a God of Destruction. He is driven by a strong sense of justice and a desire to protect the innocent.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power
Losing to Goku in the Tournament of Power

name: Trunks
description: Vegeta and Bulma's son from an alternate future, Trunks is a powerful Saiyan who travels to the past to warn Goku and his friends about the coming threat of the Androids.  Trunks is a determined and courageous warrior who is willing to fight for what he believes in, even when faced with seemingly insurmountable odds.
key_events: Traveling to the past to warn Goku

name: Bulma
description: A brilliant scientist and inventor, Bulma is a key figure in the Dragon Ball franchise.  She is known for her intelligence, determination, and her ability to create advanced technology. Bulma is a vital member of Goku's group and often provides critical support during their battles against powerful enemies.
key_events: Developing technology to aid Goku and his friends

name: Krillin
description: Goku's best friend and a talented martial artist, Krillin is a loyal and dedicated warrior who always stands by his friends.  Krillin is known for his kind-hearted nature and his determination to protect the innocent, even though he lacks the raw power of some of his allies.

name: Android 18
description: Originally an antagonist created by Dr. Gero, Android 18 was designed to kill Goku. She eventually joins the Z Fighters after her defeat, settling down and marrying Krillin.  Despite her android nature, she is a fierce fighter and protective of her family.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Android 17
description: Android 17 is the twin brother of Android 18, originally designed by Dr. Gero to kill Goku. He was freed by Goku and becomes a key character who later goes on to help save the universe.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Yamcha
description: A former desert bandit, Yamcha becomes a friend to Goku and the Z fighters.  While he may not be as strong as the Saiyans, he is a skilled fighter and an important part of the team.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Tien Shinhan
description: A stoic and dedicated martial artist, Tien Shinhan is one of Goku's most trusted allies. He is known for his discipline and his unique techniques, as well as his third eye.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Chiaotzu
description: A small and unique human with psychic powers, Chiaotzu is a close friend and companion to Tien Shinhan, and is always there to support his allies.

name: Master Roshi
description: A perverted but powerful martial arts master, Master Roshi was Goku's first teacher. He is known for his eccentric personality and his perverted antics, but he is also a wise and skilled martial artist.
key_events: Participating in the Tournament of Power

name: Videl
description: The daughter of Hercule Satan and Gohan's Wife. She is a skilled martial artist who has a strong sense of justice. She was initially skeptical of the Z-Fighters, but later joins their cause.

name: Hercule Satan
description: A champion martial artist, Hercule is renowned for taking all the credit of the Z-Fighters deeds, and is seen by the world as Earth's savior.
key_events: Winning the world Martial Arts Tournament
Taking credit for defeating Majin Buu

name: Goten
description: Goku's second son, Goten is a playful and energetic Saiyan. He is often seen with Trunks, causing mischief.
key_events: Fusing with Trunks to form Gotenks

name: Pan
description: Gohan and Videl's daughter, Pan is a playful and determined young Saiyan who loves to adventure.
key_events: Participating in the World Martial Arts Tournament

name: Zamasu
description: A former North Kai of Universe 10, who was consumed by his hatred for mortals.  He stole Goku's body and tried to exterminate all mortals. He is a powerful and dangerous antagonist who believes that mortals are the source of all evil.
key_events: Merging with an alternative timeline version of himself
